schema: Proposed designs of cherrystudio.art, shown beside the live site in Mastermind's Media cortex, Site tab (TH-752). Each entry in `designs`: name (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 42; the branch is design/<name>), status (proposed, chosen or retired), date (YYYY-MM-DD), note (optional text, at most 500 characters), and exactly one of preview (the https Vercel preview of design/<name>: https://cherry-shin-website-git-design-<name>-modrev.vercel.app/, or a deployment URL https://cherry-shin-website-<id>-modrev.vercel.app/) or local (a folder under designs/ holding a static build, served by Mastermind at http://127.0.0.1:4752/<folder>/). An entry outside these rules is listed as refused and never loaded. See README, Proposing a design.

designs.name: hero-reveal
designs.note: TH-756: the profile builds in on screen (CSS transitions, the MKB hero-motion note's middle option), unmeasured figures read a dash, and a per-platform breakdown shows silent platforms. The about paragraph is an empty slot. Not one of Cherry's ten prototypes (MRO-574).
